items.title: Tabs
items.description: YoRHa system-menu tabs on Base UI Tabs: uppercase tracked labels, the active tab inverts over a dark indicator that slides under --motion-panel, arrow/Home/End keyboard selection.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Built on Base UI; ornaments are drawn with CSS only. Compose Tabs, TabsList (give it aria-label), TabsTab, TabsPanel. Strip scrolls when tabs outgrow it (V4-180): tabs keep their label width, the selected tab is revealed, keyboard focus is an inset ring (v4 migration: was outset). Set --yorha-scroll-ground when the strip is not on the page background.
